verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no verifiable identity for AI agents themselves: no registered agent profiles, no per-agent signatures, and no trust tiers. The PayPal-issued JWTs on the merchant cart API authenticate PayPal's Shopping Cart service, not the calling agent, because the docs say PayPal's service 'not the AI agent directly' calls the merchant. That is an adjacent intermediary-authentication control, not agent identification.

support.subject: As a merchant, agents identify themselves verifiably — registered profiles, signatures, or trust tiers — so I can tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots
